scope: Core page interaction audit and fixes
fixes: Hardened delegated homepage click handling with safe closest() guards so text-node targets cannot break quick access, search results, stars, tabs, or directory actions.
Added search combobox aria-expanded / aria-controls / aria-selected state updates for command palette keyboard navigation.
Made Quick access clear action context-aware: recent tab clears recent tools; favorites tab clears saved favorites and syncs stars.
Hydrated recently used rows from the current manifest so renamed tools, hrefs, icons, and language labels do not stale-lock old localStorage values.
Removed misleading duplicate Load sample buttons for GUID, password, and timestamp pages; sample button now appears only when the active tool has a real sample.
Changed core Clear behavior so generator/time pages stay empty after Clear instead of immediately regenerating startup output.
Added regex empty-pattern guard to avoid zero-length match noise when users click Test Regex before entering a pattern.
Added URL-safe Base64 decode and missing-padding recovery to core Base64 and homepage Base64 preview actions.
Upgraded calculator expression engine to support postfix percentages while keeping binary modulo behavior.
